References cited by the documents explaining the 1970s US stagflation

Source: R/Ref_stagflation.R
Ref_stagflation.Rd

The direct citations of the corpus of Goutsmedt (2021) : one row per link between a document of Nodes_stagflation explaining the stagflation and a document it cites. It is the bipartite relation that build_network() and build_dynamic_networks() project into a bibliographic coupling network.

Usage

Ref_stagflation

Format

A data frame with 4,416 rows and 6 variables:

source_id

Identifier of the citing document.

target_id

Identifier of the cited document.

target_author

Author of the cited document.

target_year

Year of publication of the cited document.

target_title

Title of the cited document.

target_journal

Journal of the cited document, for articles.

Source

Goutsmedt (2021) .

References

Goutsmedt A (2021). “From the Stagflation to the Great Inflation: Explaining the US Economy of the 1970s.” Revue d'Économie Politique, 131(3), 557–582. https://www.cairn.info/revue-d-economie-politique-2021-3-page-557.htm.
